svg.data-cooling: host airflow, 500 LFM required (no onboard fans)
svg.data-timing-roles: IEEE 1588v2 T-GM, T-BC/OC (G.8275.1 telecom profile); SyncE with ESMC; PTP offload and redundancy; Assisted FTS
svg.data-clock-specs: G.8271.1, G.8272 PRTC, G.8273.2 T-BC/T-TSC, G.8273.4 APTS (via firmware upgrade), G.8262 EEC, G.8262.1 eEEC, G.8264 ESMC
svg.data-oran-sync: O-RAN LLS C1, C2, C3 synchronization topologies
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR, 25G SFP28 CR DAC, 10G SFP+ SR/LR, SFP+ Twinax (datasheet supported-accessories list)
svg.data-timing-cables: SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS; SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz
svg.data-interfaces: managed from the host DU server - ufiCardMgmt CLI over the E-810 network interface to the card's management IP; UFI PTP Timing Software
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A

The full-height PCIe bracket (right end) and the PCIe x16 gold edge connector (right side, in the PCB plane) both extend beyond these figures and are not modelled, per the body-between-the-ear-folds rule - they are how the card mounts, not what it is. LED holes 2.0 nominal at the measured lamp centres (drawn lens ~2.2 in the figure).","environment":"datasheet - operating 0-55 C, 5-95 percent RH; storage humidity 5-93 percent. Storage temperature DISAGREES between the two documents: the datasheet says -40 to 70 C, the HIG installation requirements say -40 to 65 C - same measure, same scope, different value. The manifest carries the datasheet figure (the spec-table source); registered in gaps as sources-disagree.","front-layout":"drawing - HIG fig-0005 (straight-on faceplate render, 1471x259 px). Gate 1: the plate face measures 1172 x 200 px against the datasheet 126.35 x 21.95 mm - aspect 5.86 vs 5.76, 1.8 percent - so fractions were taken per-axis at 9.276 px/mm (x, plate left edge at px 68) and 9.112 px/mm (y, top edge at px 7). SMB jack centres at x 18.65 / 31.37, y 11.0 (visually centred, plate centre 10.97); SMA centre (119.42, 9.77); SFP28 cage block px 426-1096 giving centres x 47.62 / 65.68 / 83.74 / 101.80 on an 18.06 mm pitch, cage vertical centre y 11.85; port LEDs (green, one per port, left of each number tag) centres x 43.99 / 61.88 / 79.67 / 97.46 at y 4.17. The photo confirms every count and the left-to-right order (1PPS, 10MHz, ports 0-3, GNSS ANT). The bracket retention screw head on the plate's left end reads 6.5 mm at centre (6.41, 7.46); drawn with common/screw-head at its 3.6 mm contract size, delta recorded here.","port-leds":"drawing - one green lamp per SFP28 port, above the cage's left half beside the yellow port-number tag (HIG fig-0005; photo confirms). HIG 3.1: Off = no cable/no traffic, blinking green = 25G TX/RX, blinking amber = 10G or less TX/RX. The yellow number tags (5.9 x 2.85 mm, measured from the figure) are drawn as decor with the numeral as silkscreen ink on top.","power":"datasheet - 'Max power Consumption: 48 Watts, Typical Power Consumption: 34 Watts' under the Power Supply row; the HIG repeats the 48 W maximum. Power is drawn from the host PCIe slot; there is no PSU.","rear-layout":"estimated - no straight-on rear source. Angled renders (datasheet fig-0002, HIG fig-0003) show an unidentified SFP-cage-like connector standing on the rear edge near the left corner - no document names it, so it is NOT drawn; registered as a gap per the unidentified-feature precedent (gl-8xep right-side boss).","side-layout":"estimated - both sides are the enclosure cover over the PCB edge; only the angled renders show them, so positions are estimates. LEFT side (x=0 = REAR per house convention) carries a micro-USB receptacle on the PCB near the front (datasheet fig-0002 bottom-left; centre estimated 13 mm behind the faceplate at PCB level) - the part is unmistakably a micro-USB, its function is stated nowhere (gap). RIGHT side (x=0 = FRONT) is the PCIe edge: the gold x16 edge connector extends beyond this face in the PCB plane and is not drawn; the face shows the cover over the PCB strip.","silkscreen":"drawing - 1PPS, 10MHZ (spelled with a capital Z as printed) and GNSS ANT in dark ink below their jacks, port numerals 0-3 in black on the yellow tags; transcribed from fig-0005 and confirmed against the photo. It carries NO printed legend on the plate - the name exists only in the guide.
